repos.description: A collective list of free APIs
repos.summary_zh: public-apis 是一个由社区维护的免费 API 集合库，涵盖地理定位、金融、天气、通信等多个领域，提供即用型 RESTful API 接口，支持 Postman 一键调用，助力开发者快速集成第三方数据服务。
repos.summary_en: The public-apis repository is a community-curated collection of free, ready-to-use REST APIs across diverse domains like geolocation, finance, weather, and communication, enabling developers to quickly integrate third-party data services via Postman.

repos.description: Supercharge your AI agents with data from the web and beyond. Building the library for superintelligence. 🔥
repos.summary_zh: Firecrawl 是一个专为 AI 设计的网页数据 API，可将任意网站转换为 LLM 可直接使用的结构化数据（如 Markdown、JSON、截图等），支持 JavaScript 渲染、动态内容抓取、批量处理和内容变更监控，显著提升 AI 应用的数据获取效率与准确性。
repos.summary_en: Firecrawl is a web data API designed for AI, converting any website into LLM-ready structured data (e.g., Markdown, JSON, screenshots). It supports JavaScript rendering, dynamic content extraction, batch processing, and change tracking, significantly enhancing data acquisition for AI applications.

repos.description: User-friendly AI Interface (Supports Ollama, OpenAI API, ...)
repos.summary_zh: Open WebUI 是一个功能丰富的自托管 AI 平台，支持 Ollama 和 OpenAI API，内置 RAG 推理引擎，提供插件扩展、多用户权限管理、响应式设计、PWA 移动端体验、语音视频通话、模型构建器及原生 Python 函数调用等核心功能，适用于离线部署与 AI 应用开发。
repos.summary_en: Open WebUI is a feature-rich, self-hosted AI platform supporting Ollama and OpenAI APIs, with built-in RAG inference engine, plugin extensibility, granular user permissions, responsive PWA design, voice/video calls, model builder, and native Python function calling for offline AI deployment and application development.

repos.description: Model Context Protocol Servers
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 的官方参考服务器实现，涵盖文件操作、网络抓取、Git 管理、内存存储等场景，支持多语言 SDK（Python、TypeScript 等），旨在帮助开发者理解 MCP 架构并构建安全的 LLM 工具集成方案。
repos.summary_en: This repository offers reference implementations of Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, including file system access, web fetching, Git operations, and memory management. Built with multi-language SDKs (Python, TypeScript, etc.), it serves as an educational resource for developers to build secure LLM-integrated tools using MCP.

repos.description: Opensource IDE For Exploring and Testing API's (lightweight alternative to Postman/Insomnia)
repos.summary_zh: Bruno 是一款开源的 API 探索与测试 IDE，作为 Postman 和 Insomnia 的轻量级替代方案。它采用本地文件系统存储 API 集合，使用 Bru 标记语言描述请求，支持 Git 协作，并坚持离线优先设计，保障用户数据隐私。
repos.summary_en: Bruno is an open-source IDE for exploring and testing APIs, designed as a lightweight alternative to Postman and Insomnia. It stores collections locally using the Bru markup language, supports Git-based collaboration, and operates entirely offline to ensure data privacy.

repos.description: 免费大模型API，支持免费调用GPT、DeepSeek等主流模型，免费额度10000点，每日刷新！另付费价格最低官方1-2折！
repos.summary_zh: ChatAnywhere 提供免费 ChatGPT 和 DeepSeek API 转发服务，支持 gpt-5、gpt-4o、deepseek-r1/v3、claude、gemini、grok 等主流大模型。采用 OpenAI 标准协议，兼容各类应用，支持流式响应，国内直连无需代理，免费额度每日 200 次（按 IP 和 Key 共享），适合个人非商业用途。
repos.summary_en: ChatAnywhere offers free ChatGPT and DeepSeek API key forwarding services, supporting top-tier models like gpt-5, gpt-4o, deepseek-r1/v3, claude, gemini, and grok. It uses the official OpenAI-compatible protocol, supports streaming responses, and enables direct access from China without proxies. Free tier allows 200 requests/day per IP+Key combination for personal non-commercial use.

repos.description: A simple Python Pydantic model for Honkai: Star Rail parsed data from the Mihomo API.
repos.summary_zh: mihomo 是一个专为《崩坏：星穹铁道》设计的 Python Pydantic 数据模型库，提供对 Mihomo API 解析数据的强类型支持与自动补全。支持 V1/V2 两种数据格式，内置工具函数处理角色去重与数据合并，并提供 JSON 和 Pickle 持久化方案，显著提升游戏数据集成开发效率。
repos.summary_en: mihomo is a Python Pydantic model library designed for Honkai: Star Rail, offering strongly-typed data structures and autocompletion support for parsed data from the Mihomo API. It supports both V1 and V2 data formats, includes utility functions for character deduplication and data merging, and provides JSON/Pickle persistence options, greatly enhancing game data integration workflows.

repos.description: 7.4 billion tokens per month. 34 free LLM providers. 635 free model endpoints. All behind one /v1 endpoint, plus any custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Smart routing, automatic failover, encrypted keys. Personal experimentation only.
repos.summary_zh: FreeLLMAPI 是一款聚合 16 家主流 AI 厂商免费额度的 OpenAI 兼容代理网关。它通过单一 /v1 端点提供约 1.7 亿 Token/月的算力，具备智能路由、自动故障转移和加密密钥存储功能，旨在解决多 SDK 调用复杂和额度分散的痛点，适合个人开发者进行低成本 AI 实验。
repos.summary_en: FreeLLMAPI is an OpenAI-compatible proxy aggregating free tiers from 16 major LLM providers into a single /v1 endpoint, delivering ~1.7B tokens/month. It features smart routing, automatic failover, and encrypted key storage, eliminating the complexity of managing multiple SDKs and scattered quotas for personal AI experimentation.

repos.description: 网易云音乐 Node.js API service
repos.summary_zh: 网易云音乐 Node.js API 服务，提供音乐播放、歌单获取、用户信息查询等功能，支持无版权限制访问。因版权政策调整，项目已停止维护，建议用户注意合规使用。
repos.summary_en: Netease Cloud Music Node.js API service offering music playback, playlist retrieval, and user data access. Now deprecated due to copyright policy changes; users advised to ensure compliance.

repos.description: YApi 是一个可本地部署的、打通前后端及QA的、可视化的接口管理平台
repos.summary_zh: YApi 是一款高效、易用、功能强大的可视化接口管理平台，支持本地部署，专为开发、产品、测试团队提供优雅的 API 管理服务。基于 Json5 和 Mockjs 定义接口结构，集成接口调试、自动化测试、Mock 期望等功能，支持 Postman/HAR/Swagger 导入，并提供丰富的插件生态与代码生成工具，助力企业级接口协作与效率提升。
repos.summary_en: YApi is a powerful, user-friendly, and efficient visual API management platform designed for developers, product managers, and QA teams. It enables seamless creation, publishing, and maintenance of APIs with features like Json5/Mockjs-based data modeling, automated testing, mock server with expectations, and support for importing from Postman, HAR, and Swagger. With a rich plugin ecosystem and code generation tools, it enhances API collaboration and productivity in enterprise environments.

repos.description: A complete and graceful API for Wechat. 微信个人号接口、微信机器人及命令行微信，三十行即可自定义个人号机器人。
repos.summary_zh: itchat 是一个基于 Python 的微信个人号完整 API，支持微信机器人开发、命令行微信及自动化操作。通过简单代码即可实现消息收发、好友管理、附件下载、群聊处理等功能，支持多开、热重载、命令行二维码显示等高级特性，适合快速构建个性化微信应用。
repos.summary_en: itchat is a complete and elegant Python API for WeChat personal accounts, enabling easy development of WeChat bots, command-line WeChat, and automation. It supports message handling, friend management, file downloads, group chat processing, multi-instance operation, hot reload, and command-line QR code display, ideal for building custom WeChat applications quickly.

repos.description: Conversational RPA SDK for Chatbot Makers. Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/7q8NBZbQzt
repos.summary_zh: Wechaty 是一个对话式 RPA SDK，专为聊天机器人开发者设计，提供跨 WhatsApp、微信等主流消息平台的统一接口，支持 TypeScript、Python、Go 等多语言开发，实现一次编写多平台运行，显著降低聊天机器人开发复杂度。
repos.summary_en: Wechaty is a conversational RPA SDK that simplifies chatbot development by offering a universal interface across messaging platforms like WhatsApp and WeChat. It supports multiple languages including TypeScript and Python, enabling developers to write once and deploy anywhere, streamlining bot creation with open-source ease and community support.

repos.description: Turn any website into a structured API. Extract, automate, search and monitor the web.
repos.summary_zh: Maxun 是一个开源无代码平台，专为实时网页抓取、爬取、搜索和 AI 数据提取设计，可将任意网站快速转换为结构化 API。支持录制操作、自然语言驱动提取、网页转 Markdown/HTML 及全站爬取，适用于构建自动化数据流水线，无需编程即可实现复杂的数据采集任务。
repos.summary_en: Maxun is an open-source no-code platform for real-time web scraping, crawling, search, and AI-powered data extraction. It transforms any website into a structured API in minutes, offering recorder mode, LLM-driven extraction, full-page scraping, and scalable crawling—ideal for building automated data pipelines without coding.

repos.description: 抖音 / TikTok 平台作品下载/数据采集工具
repos.summary_zh: DouK-Downloader 是一款基于 Python 和 HTTPX 的免费开源数据采集工具，支持批量下载抖音/TikTok 视频、图集、直播、合集及评论数据。具备 Web UI、API 接口、多线程下载、代理支持、增量采集、文件断点续传等功能，可部署至私有或公开服务器，适用于内容创作者、数据分析师等场景。
repos.summary_en: DouK-Downloader is a free open-source data collection tool built with Python and HTTPX, enabling batch downloads of videos, albums, live streams, collections, and comments from Douyin/TikTok. It features Web UI, API interface, multi-threaded downloads, proxy support, incremental scraping, and resume capability, deployable on private or public servers for content creators and data analysts.

repos.description: 微信机器人 / 可能是最优雅的微信个人号 API ✨✨
repos.summary_zh: wxpy 是基于 itchat 封装的优雅微信个人号 API，提供对象化接口与丰富功能扩展，支持自动回复、消息转发、好友管理、智能家居控制等场景，集成聊天机器人与实用工具组件，兼容 Python 2.7 及 3.4-3.6，适合实现微信自动化操作。
repos.summary_en: wxpy is an elegant WeChat personal account API built on itchat, offering object-oriented interfaces and extensive feature extensions. It supports auto-reply, message forwarding, friend/group management, smart home control, and integrates chatbots and utilities. Compatible with Python 2.7 and 3.4-3.6, ideal for WeChat automation.

repos.summary_zh: Context Hub 为编码智能体提供版本化、语言特定的 API 文档管理，支持搜索、获取和反馈功能。通过本地注释和全局反馈机制，智能体可不断积累经验并提升代码准确性，所有内容以 Markdown 格式开源维护，便于审查和贡献。
repos.summary_en: Context Hub provides versioned, language-specific API documentation for coding agents. It enables search, fetch, and feedback capabilities, with local annotations and global voting to improve agent performance over time. All content is open-sourced in Markdown format for transparency and community contribution.

repos.description: :octocat: A collection of APIs
repos.summary_zh: Awesome APIs 是一个精选的 API 集合库，涵盖动漫、博客、书籍、商业、日历、云服务等 40+ 领域，为开发者提供丰富的第三方接口资源，支持快速集成各类功能，提升开发效率。
repos.summary_en: Awesome APIs is a curated collection of over 40 categories of developer-friendly APIs, including anime, blogging, books, business, cloud services, and more, enabling rapid integration of diverse functionalities and enhancing development efficiency.

repos.description: ShowDoc is a tool greatly applicable for an IT team to share documents online一个非常适合IT团队的在线API文档、技术文档工具
repos.summary_zh: ShowDoc 是一款专为 IT 团队设计的在线文档协作工具，支持 API 文档、数据字典和技术说明的编写与管理。采用 Markdown 编辑，提供模板插入、版本历史、权限控制等功能，支持响应式网页和离线导出，显著提升团队文档协作效率。
repos.summary_en: ShowDoc is an online documentation tool designed for IT teams to create and share API documents, data dictionaries, and technical specs. It features Markdown editing, template insertion, version history, permission management, responsive design, and offline export, enhancing team collaboration efficiency.

repos.description: LangChain 的中文入门教程
repos.summary_zh: LangChain 中文入门教程系统讲解大模型应用开发框架，涵盖文档加载、文本分割、向量存储、Chain 链与 Agent 代理等核心概念，提供 OpenAI API 集成、PDF/YouTube 数据处理等实战案例，配套 GitBook 与 Colab 代码，适合 AI 开发者快速上手构建智能应用。
repos.summary_en: This comprehensive LangChain Chinese tutorial covers core concepts like document loading, text splitting, vectorstores, chains, and agents for building LLM-powered applications. It includes practical examples with OpenAI integration, PDF/YouTube data processing, and provides GitBook and Colab code resources for developers to quickly build AI applications.

repos.description: ✨ The agentic HTML editor — your local AI agent writes the HTML, you ship it. 🚀 75 Skills × 9 Surfaces (magazine · deck · poster · XHS / tweet · prototype · data report · Hyperframes) 🛡️ Sandboxed preview · 📤 1-click to WeChat / X / Zhihu / HTML / PNG 🔑 Zero API key — Claude Code / Cursor / Codex / Gemini / Copilot / OpenCode / Qwen / Aider.
repos.summary_zh: HTML Anything 是一款本地优先的智能 HTML 编辑器，集成 8 种主流编码代理 CLI（如 Claude Code、Cursor、Copilot 等），无需 API 密钥。提供 75 个可组合技能模板，支持 9 种输出场景（杂志、海报、数据报告、小红书卡片等），一键导出至微信、X、知乎或生成 HTML/PNG 文件。
repos.summary_en: HTML Anything is a local-first, agentic HTML editor that integrates 8 coding agent CLIs (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) with zero API key required. It offers 75 composable skill templates across 9 deliverable formats—from magazines to data reports—and enables one-click export to WeChat, X, Zhihu, HTML, or PNG.

repos.description: A persistent service that generates mock data quickly and provids visualization view.
repos.summary_zh: Easy Mock 是一个快速生成模拟数据并提供可视化界面的持久化服务，支持团队协作、Swagger 导入、Mock.js 语法及自定义响应配置，适用于前后端分离开发中的接口模拟与测试。
repos.summary_en: Easy Mock is a persistent service that quickly generates mock data with a visualization interface, supporting team collaboration, Swagger import, Mock.js schema, and customizable responses for frontend-backend development and API testing.

repos.description: Self-hosted multi-protocol AI API proxy for Antigravity, Codex, Grok, Kiro, OpenAI, Claude, and custom providers. Supports OpenAI-compatible API, Claude API, Gemini protocol conversion, GPT, Grok Build, Claude Opus, Gemini Pro, Kimi, MiniMax, provider pools, smart routing, and automatic failover.
repos.summary_zh: AIClient2API 是一个强大的代理工具，可将 Gemini CLI、Antigravity、Codex、Grok 和 Kiro 等仅客户端大模型 API 的请求统一封装为本地 OpenAI 兼容接口，支持每日数千次 Gemini 请求，并免费使用 Kiro 内置 Claude 模型，极大提升 AI 开发效率。
repos.summary_en: AIClient2API is a powerful proxy that unifies client-only LLM APIs (Gemini CLI, Antigravity, Codex, Grok, Kiro) into a local OpenAI-compatible interface. It supports thousands of daily Gemini requests and offers free access to Kiro's built-in Claude model, streamlining AI development.

repos.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.
repos.summary_zh: Magpie 是一款轻量跨平台本地网关工具，统一管理多种 AI 编程助手（Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI 等）的模型选择与 API 路由。通过菜单栏应用、TUI 和 CLI 三种形态，无缝切换模型、共享订阅、自动同步实时模型目录，并精确编辑配置文件，实现多代理一站式编排。
repos.summary_en: Magpie is a lightweight cross-platform local gateway that centrally manages model selection and API routing for multiple AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, etc.). It offers menu-bar GUI, TUI and CLI interfaces, supports shared subscriptions, real-time model discovery, and surgical config editing for unified multi-agent orchestration.

repos.description: 收集整理Android开发所需的Android SDK、开发中用到的工具、Android开发教程、Android设计规范，免费的设计素材等。
repos.summary_zh: AndroidDevTools 是一个专注于 Android 开发的一站式资源平台，提供 Android SDK、开发工具、设计规范、教程及素材的整合。涵盖从开发环境搭建、代码生成、资源处理到设计协作的全流程工具链，支持 Android Studio、Gradle 等主流技术栈，助力开发者高效构建高质量应用。
repos.summary_en: AndroidDevTools is a comprehensive platform for Android developers, offering curated resources including Android SDK, development tools, design guidelines, tutorials, and free assets. It covers the full development lifecycle—from environment setup and code generation to resource optimization and UI design—supporting major tools like Android Studio and Gradle to enhance productivity.

repos.description: Simulates Gemini CLI, Antigravity, Codex, Grok, and Kiro client requests, compatible with the OpenAI API. It supports thousands of Gemini model requests per day and offers free use of the built-in Claude model in Kiro. Easily connect to any client via the API, making AI development more efficient!
repos.summary_zh: AIClient-2-API 是一个强大的 API 代理服务，能够将原本仅限客户端使用的大模型（如 Gemini CLI、Antigravity、Qwen Code、Kiro 等）的请求统一转换为兼容 OpenAI 协议的标准接口。支持每日数千次 Gemini 模型请求，内置 Claude 免费调用功能，提供高可用性的模块化架构，包含账户池管理、智能轮询、自动故障转移和健康检查机制，显著提升 AI 开发效率。
repos.summary_en: AIClient-2-API is a powerful proxy service that unifies requests from client-restricted large models (e.g., Gemini CLI, Antigravity, Qwen Code, Kiro) into a standard OpenAI-compatible interface. It supports thousands of daily Gemini model requests, offers free built-in Claude access, and features a modular architecture with account pooling, intelligent polling, automatic failover, and health checks for 99.9% uptime, greatly enhancing AI development efficiency.

repos.summary_zh: Craft Agents 是一款基于 Agent Native 理念构建的开源桌面应用，支持通过自然语言连接任意 API、MCP 服务或本地工具（如 Slack、Linear、PostgreSQL），无需配置文件。它集成 Claude 与 Pi SDK，提供多会话管理、实时技能扩展和文档导向的工作流，所有操作均可通过提示词即时完成，专为高效人机协作设计。
repos.summary_en: Craft Agents is an open-source desktop application built on Agent Native principles, enabling natural language integration with any API, MCP server, or local tool (e.g., Slack, Linear, PostgreSQL) without config files. It combines Claude and Pi SDKs, offering multi-session management, real-time skill expansion, and a document-centric workflow—all customizable via prompts for seamless human-agent collaboration.

repos.description: Self-hosted AI gateway for multi-channel, multi-credential setups — API keys and subscription accounts, scheduling, failover, request logs and usage. 自托管 AI 网关：多渠道多凭据统一接入，含密钥与订阅账号、调度容错、日志与用量。
repos.summary_zh: GPT-Load 是一个高性能企业级 AI API 透明代理服务，专为需要集成多 AI 服务的开发者和企业设计。基于 Go 构建，具备智能密钥轮询、负载均衡、故障自动恢复、动态配置热重载等特性，支持 OpenAI、Google Gemini、Anthropic Claude 等多种 AI 服务格式，提供完整的监控和管理界面。
repos.summary_en: GPT-Load is a high-performance, enterprise-grade transparent proxy service for AI APIs, designed for developers and enterprises integrating multiple AI services. Built with Go, it features intelligent key rotation, load balancing, automatic failure recovery, hot-reload configuration, and comprehensive monitoring. Supports OpenAI, Google Gemini, and Anthropic Claude APIs with a Vue 3 management interface.

repos.description: Embrace the APIs of the future. Hug aims to make developing APIs as simple as possible, but no simpler.
repos.summary_zh: Hug 是一个极简且高性能的 Python API 框架，基于 Falcon 构建，大幅简化 API 开发流程。支持自动文档生成、参数类型转换、路由装饰器等功能，强调自文档化、快速开发和测试友好，适用于现代 Python 后端服务开发。
repos.summary_en: Hug is a minimalist, high-performance Python API framework built on Falcon that simplifies API development. It features automatic documentation, type conversion, decorators for routing, and emphasizes self-documenting code, fast development, and easy testing for modern Python backend services.

repos.description: 🚀 Free HTTP, SOCKS4, & SOCKS5 proxy list * Updated every 5 minutes * and rotating proxy API (100+ countries)
repos.summary_zh: Proxifly 是一个高性能的免费代理 IP 池，每 5 分钟自动抓取并验证全球 HTTP、HTTPS、SOCKS4 和 SOCKS5 代理。提供 JSON、TXT、CSV 多格式下载及 NPM 模块，支持按国家与协议筛选，适用于网页爬虫、数据抓取与隐私保护等场景。
repos.summary_en: Proxifly is a high-performance free proxy pool that automatically scrapes and validates global HTTP, HTTPS, SOCKS4, and SOCKS5 proxies every 5 minutes. It offers multi-format downloads (JSON, TXT, CSV), an NPM module, and filtering by country/protocol, ideal for web scraping, data extraction, and privacy protection.

repos.description: Curated list of apps and tools that not only use the new ChatGPT API, but also allow users to configure their own API keys, enabling free and on-demand usage of their own quota.
repos.summary_zh: Awesome ChatGPT API 是一个精心策划的资源列表，汇集了支持用户自定义 API 密钥的应用和工具，实现免费按需调用自有配额。涵盖浏览器插件、Web/桌面应用、CLI 工具及开发资源，适用于多场景 AI 集成，如翻译、搜索摘要、代码辅助等，助力开发者构建高效 ChatGPT 生态。
repos.summary_en: Awesome ChatGPT API is a curated collection of apps and tools that support custom API key configuration, enabling free on-demand usage of personal quotas. It includes browser extensions, web/desktop apps, CLI tools, and development resources, supporting diverse AI integrations like translation, search summarization, and code assistance for building a robust ChatGPT ecosystem.

repos.description: Gemini polling proxy service （gemini轮询代理服务）
repos.summary_zh: Gemini Balance 是一个基于 FastAPI 的 Gemini API 代理与负载均衡服务，支持多密钥轮询、OpenAI 格式兼容、图像文本对话、网页搜索及实时状态监控，提供灵活的配置管理和详细的日志追踪。
repos.summary_en: Gemini Balance is a FastAPI-based proxy and load balancer for Google's Gemini API, enabling multi-key polling, OpenAI API compatibility, image-text chat, web search, and real-time key status monitoring with dynamic configuration and detailed logging.

repos.description: Postcat 是一个可扩展的 API 工具平台。集合基础的 API 管理和测试功能，并且可以通过插件简化你的 API 开发工作，让你可以更快更好地创建 API。An extensible API tool.
repos.summary_zh: Postcat 是一个开源、跨平台的 API 开发测试工具，支持 REST 和 WebSocket 协议，具备 API 管理、测试、Mock 及团队协作功能。通过插件系统实现功能扩展，提供多语言界面与自定义主题，适用于中小团队快速构建和验证 API。
repos.summary_en: Postcat is an open-source, cross-platform API development and testing tool supporting REST and WebSocket protocols. It offers API management, testing, Mock, team collaboration, and extensibility via plugins. With customizable themes and multi-language support, it enables efficient API creation and validation for small to medium teams.

repos.description: Your Friendly Open-Source Gen-AI Platform
repos.summary_zh: Pollinations.ai 是一个开源生成式 AI 平台，提供免费的文本到图像、音频、视频和文本生成 API，支持多种模型如 Stable Diffusion 和 Llama。开发者可通过简单 API 调用快速集成 AI 能力，适用于创意项目、应用开发和自动化内容生成，社区活跃且持续扩展应用场景。
repos.summary_en: Pollinations.ai is an open-source generative AI platform offering free APIs for text-to-image, audio, video, and text generation using models like Stable Diffusion and Llama. It enables developers to integrate AI capabilities via simple API calls, supporting creative projects, app development, and automated content creation with an active community and growing ecosystem.

repos.description: 🚀 KIMI AI 长文本大模型逆向API【特长：长文本解读整理】，支持高速流式输出、智能体对话、联网搜索、探索版、K1思考模型、长文档解读、图像解析、多轮对话，零配置部署，多路token支持，自动清理会话痕迹，仅供测试，如需商用请前往官方开放平台。
repos.summary_zh: KIMI AI 长文本大模型逆向API，支持高速流式输出、多轮对话、联网搜索、智能体对话、长文档解读及图像解析，零配置部署，兼容ChatGPT接口，支持多路token轮询与自动会话清理，仅供测试用途。
repos.summary_en: KIMI AI long-text LLM reverse API supporting high-speed streaming, multi-turn dialogue, web search, agent conversations, document interpretation, and image parsing. Zero-config deployment, ChatGPT-compatible interface, multi-token support, and automatic session cleanup. For testing only.

repos.description: Use any LLMs (Large Language Models) for Deep Research. Support SSE API and MCP server.
repos.summary_zh: Deep Research 是一个基于 AI 的极速深度研究工具，支持多 LLM 模型（如 Gemini、OpenAI、Anthropic 等）和主流搜索引擎，可在约 2 分钟内生成高质量研究报告。采用 Thinking 与 Task 模型协同工作，支持本地知识库构建、知识图谱可视化、内容编辑与历史记录管理，所有数据均本地处理，保障隐私安全。
repos.summary_en: Deep Research is an AI-powered tool for lightning-fast in-depth research, supporting multiple LLMs (e.g., Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic) and search engines. It generates comprehensive reports in ~2 minutes using Thinking and Task models, with local knowledge base, knowledge graph, content editing, and full privacy via on-device processing.

repos.description: Telegram Bot API server
repos.summary_zh: Telegram Bot API官方服务器实现，支持本地自托管部署。提供完整Bot API HTTP接口，支持无限制文件下载、2000MB大文件上传、自定义Webhook地址与端口。适用于高并发场景、数据隐私保护及绕过官方API限制的企业级应用。
repos.summary_en: Official Telegram Bot API server implementation supporting self-hosted deployment. Provides complete Bot API HTTP interface with unlimited file downloads, 2000MB upload support, and custom webhook configuration. Ideal for high-concurrency scenarios, data privacy protection, and enterprise applications requiring API customization.

repos.description: WeChat SDK for Python
repos.summary_zh: WeChatpy 是一个功能完整的微信公众平台第三方 Python SDK，支持普通公众平台被动响应、企业微信、微信支付、第三方平台代调用及小程序云开发等核心 API 集成，提供简洁易用的接口封装，适用于快速构建微信生态应用。
repos.summary_en: WeChatpy is a comprehensive third-party Python SDK for the WeChat public platform, supporting core APIs such as passive response, enterprise WeChat, WeChat Pay, third-party proxy calls, and mini-program cloud development, offering a clean interface for rapid integration into WeChat ecosystem applications.

repos.summary_zh: 本仓库是冬瓜关于 Pi-Agent SDK 的深度学习笔记，系统拆解了生产级 AI Agent 运行时的核心架构。教程涵盖 Agent Loop、工具系统、事件驱动等 10 大模块，通过 TypeScript 与 Python 双语言对照，深入剖析了 Agent SDK 的设计取舍与源码实现，适合希望构建或理解 Agent 底层逻辑的开发者。
repos.summary_en: A deep-dive tutorial repository on the Pi-Agent SDK, systematically deconstructing the core architecture of production-grade AI Agent runtimes. Covering 10 modules including Agent Loop, tool systems, and event-driven design, it provides TypeScript and Python dual-language comparisons to analyze the source code and design trade-offs of Agent SDKs for developers.

repos.description: Document (PDF, Word, PPTX ...) extraction and parse API using state of the art modern OCRs + Ollama supported models. Anonymize documents. Remove PII. Convert any document or picture to structured JSON or Markdown
repos.summary_zh: text-extract-api 是一个本地部署的文档提取与解析 API，支持 PDF、Word、PPT 和图片转换为高精度 Markdown 或结构化 JSON，集成 EasyOCR、Llama3.2-vision 等先进 OCR 模型及 Ollama 大模型，具备 PII 匿名化、分布式 Celery 队列处理、Redis 缓存等功能，无需依赖云端服务。
repos.summary_en: text-extract-api is a locally deployed document extraction and parsing API that converts images, PDFs, and Office documents into high-accuracy Markdown or structured JSON using advanced OCRs like EasyOCR and Llama3.2-vision, integrated with Ollama LLMs for text refinement and PII removal. It features distributed Celery processing, Redis caching, and no external cloud dependencies.

repos.description: JSON Web Token Authentication support for Django REST Framework
repos.summary_zh: 该项目为 Django REST Framework 提供 JSON Web Token (JWT) 身份验证支持，实现无状态用户认证。适用于需要安全、可扩展 API 的场景，如前后端分离应用。现已停止维护，建议使用官方或活跃替代方案。
repos.summary_en: This package adds JSON Web Token (JWT) authentication support for Django REST Framework, enabling stateless API security. Ideal for modern web applications requiring secure, scalable authentication. Note: Project is unmaintained; alternatives recommended.

repos.description: 做最好的接口管理平台
repos.summary_zh: DOClever 是一款专为中小型团队打造的商业化开源接口管理平台，完全免费并支持内网部署。它提供接口全生命周期管理、可视化调试、Mock 服务、自动化测试、团队协作及多格式导入导出等功能，支持 HTTP/HTTPS 协议及多种参数类型，具备版本控制与快照能力，助力高效开发协作。
repos.summary_en: DOClever is a commercial open-source API management platform, fully free and supportable for on-premise deployment. It offers comprehensive API lifecycle management, visual debugging, Mock services, automated testing, team collaboration, and import/export in multiple formats. Supporting HTTP/HTTPS protocols and various parameter types, it features version control, snapshots, and seamless integration with Postman, Swagger, and RAP.

repos.description: 🚀 DeepSeek-V3 & R1大模型逆向API【特长：良心厂商】（官方贼便宜，建议直接走官方），支持高速流式输出、多轮对话，联网搜索，R1深度思考，零配置部署，多路token支持，仅供测试，如需商用请前往官方开放平台。
repos.summary_zh: 本项目提供 DeepSeek-V3 和 R1 大模型的逆向 API 接口，支持高速流式输出、多轮对话、联网搜索及深度思考功能，兼容 ChatGPT 接口标准，支持零配置部署与多账号 token 负载均衡，仅限个人测试使用，商用请转官方平台。
repos.summary_en: This project provides a reverse-engineered API for DeepSeek-V3 and R1 models, featuring high-speed streaming output, multi-turn conversations, web search, and deep reasoning. It is fully compatible with ChatGPT's API interface, supports zero-configuration deployment and multi-token load balancing, intended only for personal testing, commercial use requires official platform access.

repos.description: Swagger Documentation Generator for Django REST Framework: deprecated
repos.summary_zh: Django REST Swagger 是一个为 Django REST Framework 提供 Swagger 文档生成的工具，现已废弃。它通过 OpenAPIRenderer 和 SwaggerUIRenderer 自动生成 API 的 OpenAPI 规范及交互式文档界面，支持自定义标题和路由配置，适用于快速构建可浏览的 REST API 文档。
repos.summary_en: Django REST Swagger was a deprecated tool for generating Swagger documentation for Django REST Framework. It provided OpenAPIRenderer and SwaggerUIRenderer to auto-generate API specs and interactive UI, enabling browsable REST API docs with customizable titles and routing, now succeeded by drf-yasg.

repos.description: Connect to any agents with WeChat ClawBot.
repos.summary_zh: WeClaw 是一个 WeChat AI Agent 桥接工具，支持连接 Claude、Codex、Gemini 等主流 AI 模型。通过 QR 码登录微信后自动检测并集成已安装的 AI 代理，提供 ACP/CLI/HTTP 三种交互模式，支持消息转发、图片文件传输、Markdown 转换及主动推送功能，具备持久化配置和命令行/API 双重控制能力。
repos.summary_en: WeClaw is a WeChat AI Agent Bridge that connects WeChat to AI agents like Claude, Codex, and Gemini. It auto-detects installed agents via QR login, supports ACP/CLI/HTTP modes, handles media/image forwarding, converts markdown responses, and enables proactive messaging via CLI or HTTP API with persistent config.

repos.description: Google Assistant for macOS!
repos.summary_zh: MacAssistant 是一款将 Google Assistant 集成到 macOS 的 Swift 应用，支持语音交互与系统控制。通过 Google Assistant SDK 实现自然语言处理，支持天气查询、日程管理等常见指令，需用户自行配置 OAuth 凭证。项目采用 Swift 4.2 开发，基于 gRPC 和 Protocol Buffers，提供跨平台语音助手解决方案。
repos.summary_en: MacAssistant is a Swift-based macOS app integrating Google Assistant via the Google Assistant SDK, enabling voice interaction and system control. It supports natural language queries like weather and agenda, requiring user-provided OAuth credentials. Built with Swift 4.2, gRPC, and Protocol Buffers, it offers a cross-platform voice assistant solution for macOS.

repos.description: Multi-service toolkit for Tavily and Firecrawl signup automation, key validation, and isolated proxy pools.
repos.summary_zh: 该工具专注于自动化注册和验证 Tavily、Firecrawl 及 Exa 的 API Key，支持多服务并发注册、邮箱验证码自动处理、真实接口可用性验证，并可选上传至统一代理池，为 MySearch-Proxy 提供稳定上游密钥源。
repos.summary_en: This toolkit automates registration and validation of API keys for Tavily, Firecrawl, and Exa. It supports concurrent signups, email verification handling, real-time API testing, and optional upload to a unified proxy pool, serving as a reliable upstream key provider for MySearch-Proxy.

repos.description: DRF-extensions is a collection of custom extensions for Django REST Framework
repos.summary_zh: DRF-extensions 是 Django REST Framework 的扩展集合，提供 DetailSerializerMixin、缓存、条件请求、嵌套路由和批量操作等核心功能，支持多版本 Django 和 DRF，文档完善，适合企业级 API 开发。
repos.summary_en: DRF-extensions is a collection of custom extensions for Django REST Framework, offering features like DetailSerializerMixin, caching, conditional requests, nested routes, and bulk operations. It supports multiple Django and DRF versions with comprehensive documentation, ideal for enterprise-grade API development.

repos.description: Desktop Agent for Any Task
repos.summary_zh: WorkAny 是一款桌面 AI 智能体应用，通过自然语言指令执行复杂任务，支持实时代码生成、工具调用和沙箱环境运行。基于 Claude Agent SDK 构建，集成 MCP 协议与多模型供应商，提供文件管理、文档/网页/表格/幻灯片生成等全场景能力，适用于自动化办公与软件开发。
repos.summary_en: WorkAny is a desktop AI agent that executes tasks via natural language, featuring real-time code generation, sandboxed execution, and workspace management. Built on Claude Agent SDK with MCP support and multi-provider LLM integration, it enables automated file organization, document/web/table/slide generation, and software development workflows.

repos.description: 微信公众平台 Python 开发包 [DEPRECATED]
repos.summary_zh: wechat-python-sdk 是一个已停止维护的微信公众平台 Python 开发包，支持订阅号和服务号官方接口，提供消息处理、加解密、模板消息等功能。该 SDK 设计为轻量级，便于集成到各类 Web 框架中，不处理 HTTP 请求响应，仅封装微信 API 操作并返回合规响应数据。
repos.summary_en: wechat-python-sdk was a deprecated Python SDK for WeChat Official Accounts (subscription/service accounts), offering message handling, encryption/decryption, template messages, and menu management. It focused on simplifying WeChat API integration by returning compliant response data without handling HTTP layers, designed for easy integration into web frameworks.

repos.description: 一款完全开源的微信公众号文章获取、RSS 订阅 API 服务，支持整号文章一键导出 7 种格式（Markdown/HTML/Word/PDF/EPUB/Excel/JSON）、IP 代理池反风控、MCP 接入各种 AI Agent 工具。
repos.summary_zh: 完全开源的微信公众号文章获取与RSS订阅API服务，支持Chrome TLS指纹模拟、SOCKS5代理池反风控，提供公众号搜索、文章抓取、图片代理及Webhook通知功能。基于FastAPI构建，支持Docker一键部署和多架构兼容，本地扫码登录即可使用。
repos.summary_en: Fully open-source WeChat public account article fetching and RSS subscription API service with Chrome TLS fingerprint simulation, SOCKS5 proxy pool anti-detection, supporting account search, article scraping, image proxy, and webhook notifications. Built on FastAPI, Docker-deployable across multiple architectures, accessible via local QR login.

repos.description: 🚀 即梦3.0逆向API【特长：图像生成顶流】，零配置部署，多路token支持，仅供测试，如需商用请前往官方开放平台。
repos.summary_zh: 即梦3.0逆向API服务，提供零配置部署的图像生成能力，支持多路token并发，兼容OpenAI接口标准，每日免费66次生成额度，适用于个人测试与学习用途。
repos.summary_en: Jimeng AI Free API service enables zero-configuration deployment of image generation via reverse-engineered API, supporting multiple tokens and OpenAI-compatible interface, offering 66 daily free generations for testing purposes.

repos.description: Cache-based rate-limiting for Django
repos.summary_zh: Django Ratelimit 是一个基于缓存的 Django 速率限制中间件，通过装饰器为视图提供灵活的限流功能，支持基于 IP 地址或请求参数（GET/POST）进行访问控制，适用于防止滥用和保障 API 安全。
repos.summary_en: Django Ratelimit is a cache-based rate-limiting library for Django that uses decorators to limit view access, configurable by IP address or request parameters (GET/POST), ideal for preventing abuse and securing APIs.

repos.description: Free gemini-3-flash  | cursor不倒我不倒🙏 ❌ 这次倒下啦
repos.summary_zh: Cursor2API 是一个将 Cursor Web 转换为 OpenAI 兼容 API 的高性能服务，支持 Claude Sonnet 4.6 模型，提供完全兼容 OpenAI API 格式的接口，具备低延迟响应、安全认证、流式/非流式输出及完善的错误处理机制，可通过 Docker、系统服务或本地编译部署。
repos.summary_en: Cursor2API is a high-performance service that converts Cursor Web into an OpenAI-compatible API, supporting Claude Sonnet 4.6. It offers full OpenAI API compatibility with low-latency responses, secure authentication, streaming/non-streaming support, and robust error handling, deployable via Docker, systemd, or local compilation.

repos.description: Free gemini-3-flash  | cursor不倒我不倒🙏 ❌ 这次倒下啦
repos.summary_zh: Cursor2API 是一个将 Cursor Web 转换为 OpenAI chat/completions API 兼容服务的 Go 项目，支持 Google Gemini-3-flash 模型及自动派生的 thinking 版本，具备高性能、安全认证、工具调用和流式响应等特性，提供 Docker 和系统服务部署方案。
repos.summary_en: Cursor2API is a Go service that converts Cursor Web into an OpenAI chat/completions API-compatible endpoint, supporting Google Gemini-3-flash and its thinking variant. It offers high performance, secure authentication, tool calls, streaming responses, and supports deployment via Docker or systemd services.

repos.description: A CLI for BOSS 直聘 — search jobs, view recommendations, manage applications via reverse-engineered API
repos.summary_zh: boss-cli 是一个基于逆向工程 API 的 BOSS 直聘命令行工具，支持职位搜索、个性化推荐、申请管理、与招聘者聊天及发送问候等功能。具备多浏览器 Cookie 自动提取、丰富筛选条件、结构化输出和跨平台支持，适用于求职自动化场景。
repos.summary_en: boss-cli is a CLI tool for BOSS Zhipin that enables job searching, recommendations, application management, and recruiter chat via reverse-engineered APIs. It supports browser cookie extraction, advanced filtering, structured output, and cross-platform usage for automated job hunting.

repos.description: 🦄 The world's largest Midjourney drawing API, generating over 1 million drawings daily, supporting Discord Youchuan Midjourney 🐂！
repos.summary_zh: Midjourney API 是全球最大的 Midjourney 绘图 API 代理项目，日生成图像超百万张，完全免费开源。支持 Discord 绘图、悠船绘图及官网接入，提供 Imagine、Vary、Remix 等全套指令，集成账号池管理、多数据库支持、负载均衡、CloudFlare 验证绕过、图片/视频一键换脸等功能，适用于企业级绘图服务部署。
repos.summary_en: Midjourney API is the world's largest free and open-source proxy for Midjourney's Discord channel, generating over 1 million images daily. It supports full-featured drawing via Discord, YouChuan, and official Midjourney, with comprehensive commands like Imagine, Vary, Remix, account pooling, load balancing, CloudFlare bypass, image/video face swap, and enterprise-grade deployment features.

repos.description: TTSFM mirrors OpenAI's TTS service, providing a compatible interface for text-to-speech conversion with multiple voice options for free.
repos.summary_zh: TTSFM 是一个免费的 OpenAI 兼容文本转语音 API 服务，基于 OpenAI GPT-4o mini TTS 提供多语音选项、6种音频格式支持、速度调节和实时流式生成，包含 Python SDK、Web 交互界面及 Docker 部署方案，适用于教育与研究场景。
repos.summary_en: TTSFM is a free, OpenAI-compatible text-to-speech API service based on OpenAI's GPT-4o mini TTS, offering 11 voice options, 6 audio formats, speed control (0.25x–4.0x), real-time streaming, Python SDK, web playground, and Docker deployment for educational and research use.

repos.description: Python爬虫，返回一定格式的信息，下载，使用flask提供简易api。抖音无水印、皮皮虾、快手、网易云音乐、qq音乐、咪咕音乐、荔枝FM音频、知乎视频、最右语音、视频、微博......
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是一个基于 Python 的网页爬虫集合，支持抖音、快手、网易云音乐、知乎等平台的无水印视频、音频及内容下载，通过 Flask 提供简易 API 接口。代码风格较旧但功能实用，现计划迁移至 FastAPI 框架重构，适合学习或日常使用。
repos.summary_en: This project is a collection of Python web crawlers for downloading unwatermarked videos, audio, and content from platforms like Douyin, Kuaishou, NetEase Music, and Zhihu. It provides a simple API via Flask. The codebase is outdated but functional, with plans to migrate to FastAPI for better structure and usability.

repos.description: Document Web APIs made with Django Rest Framework
repos.summary_zh: DRF Docs 是一个专为 Django Rest Framework 设计的 API 文档自动生成工具，支持 Python 2.7/3.x 和 Django 1.8+。它能自动解析 DRF 项目中的 API 结构，生成交互式文档页面，并提供配置选项控制文档可见性。项目包含演示环境，支持模板扩展，适用于需要快速搭建标准化 API 文档的中大型后端服务。
repos.summary_en: DRF Docs is an automated API documentation generator for Django Rest Framework, supporting Python 2.7/3.x and Django 1.8+. It auto-generates interactive API docs by parsing DRF project structures, with configurable visibility and template extension support. Includes a demo project for development and testing, ideal for medium-to-large backend services requiring standardized API documentation.

repos.description: 🚀 MiniMax大模型海螺AI逆向API【特长：超自然语音】，支持MiniMax Text-01、MiniMax-VL-01模型，支持高速流式输出、语音合成、联网搜索、长文档解读、图像解析、多轮对话，零配置部署，多路token支持，自动清理会话痕迹，仅供测试，如需商用请前往官方开放平台。
repos.summary_zh: 本项目为MiniMax海螺AI提供逆向API服务，支持MiniMax-Text-01和MiniMax-VL-01模型，具备高速流式输出、语音合成与识别、联网搜索、长文档解读、图像解析及多轮对话能力。零配置部署，支持多路token并发，自动清理会话痕迹，接口兼容ChatGPT，适用于测试与个人使用。
repos.summary_en: This project provides a reverse-engineered API for MiniMax Hailuo AI, supporting MiniMax-Text-01 and MiniMax-VL-01 models. It features high-speed streaming output, speech synthesis/ASR, web search, document analysis, image parsing, and multi-turn conversations. Zero-configuration deployment, multi-token concurrency, session auto-cleanup, and full ChatGPT compatibility. For testing only; commercial use requires official platform access.

repos.description: weixin pay python 微信支付功能集，前期开发借鉴zwczou https://github.com/zwczou/weixin-python ，后期补充及完善微信支付新功能，处理因微信支付调用规则修改而无法使用的旧代码，升级到最新微信支付接口配套代码
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库是一个已停止维护的微信支付 Python SDK，提供完整的微信支付功能封装，包括 JSAPI 支付下单、订单查询、退款、红包发放、企业付款及刷卡支付等接口。基于 zwczou/weixin-python 开发，后期适配微信支付接口规则变更，支持证书认证和回调通知，适用于需要集成微信支付功能的 Python 后端服务。
repos.summary_en: This is a discontinued Python SDK for WeChat Pay, offering comprehensive API support including JSAPI payments, order queries, refunds, red packet distribution, enterprise transfers, and swipe-card payments. Built upon zwczou/weixin-python with updates to comply with WeChat Pay's evolving API standards, it supports certificate authentication and webhook notifications for secure payment processing in Python backends.

repos.description: 开箱即用的微信公众平台API模拟服务器，帮助你开发与调试微信公众平台应用
repos.summary_zh: Wecheat 是一个开箱即用的微信公众平台API模拟器，基于 Sinatra 框架开发，提供完整的仿真数据与消息交互功能，支持文本、图片、视频等多种消息类型及事件通知，适用于微信应用开发与调试。
repos.summary_en: Wecheat is an out-of-the-box WeChat Official Account API simulator built on the Sinatra framework, offering comprehensive fake data and message interactions including text, images, videos, and events, ideal for developing and debugging WeChat applications.

repos.description: Douban Search App Based on React Native
repos.summary_zh: React-Dou 是基于 React Native 和豆瓣开放 API 开发的跨平台搜索应用，支持图书、音乐、电影三大类内容的搜索、列表展示与详情查看，具备完整的移动端交互体验，适用于快速构建豆瓣生态相关的数据检索工具。
repos.summary_en: React-Dou is a cross-platform search app built with React Native and Douban Open API, supporting search, listing, and detail views for books, music, and movies. It delivers a complete mobile experience for accessing Douban's content ecosystem.

repos.description: TTS-文本转语音/文本转语音前端，兼容OpenAI、EdgeTTS等接口
repos.summary_zh: LibreTTS 是一款开源在线文本转语音工具，支持300+种语言和口音的声音，兼容OpenAI与EdgeTTS等主流TTS接口。提供实时试听、语速语调调节、长文本分段处理、历史记录及自定义API配置功能，支持Vercel和Cloudflare Pages一键部署，适合个人或企业快速搭建私有化TTS服务。
repos.summary_en: LibreTTS is an open-source online text-to-speech tool supporting 300+ voices across multiple languages and accents. It integrates with OpenAI, EdgeTTS, and other compatible APIs, offering real-time preview, adjustable speech rate/pitch, long-text segmentation, history tracking, and custom API configuration. Deployable via Vercel or Cloudflare Pages for private TTS solutions.

repos.description: An efficient API documentation management tool that fully adheres to the OpenAPI specification and incorporates advanced LLM technology. This tool can automate the generation of API documentation, data models, and test cases, greatly enhancing development efficiency and documentation quality.
repos.summary_zh: ApiCat 是一款高效 API 文档管理工具，完全遵循 OpenAPI 规范，集成先进 LLM 技术，可自动化生成 API 文档、数据模型和测试用例，显著提升开发效率与文档质量，支持本地部署与云端服务。
repos.summary_en: ApiCat is an efficient API documentation management tool fully compliant with the OpenAPI specification. It leverages advanced LLM technology to automate API documentation, data model, and test case generation, significantly enhancing development efficiency and documentation quality. Supports local deployment and cloud services.

repos.description: SnackBase is a Python/FastAPI-based BaaS providing auto-generated REST APIs, multi-tenancy, row-level security, authentication, enterprise OAuth/SAML, and comprehensive admin UI.
repos.summary_zh: SnackBase 是一个基于 Python/FastAPI 的开源后端即服务（BaaS）平台，旨在作为 Supabase 的自托管替代方案。它提供自动生成的 REST API、多租户架构、行级安全（RLS）、企业级认证（OAuth/SAML）以及功能完备的 React 管理后台，支持 SQLite 与 PostgreSQL，助力开发者快速构建安全的企业级应用。
repos.summary_en: SnackBase is an open-source, Python/FastAPI-based Backend-as-a-Service (BaaS) platform designed as a self-hosted Supabase alternative. It offers auto-generated REST APIs, multi-tenancy, row-level security (RLS), enterprise authentication (OAuth/SAML), and a comprehensive React admin UI, supporting both SQLite and PostgreSQL for rapid enterprise application development.

repos.description: 这是一个部署在 Cloudflare Workers 上的 TypeScript 项目，它充当一个代理服务器，能够将 Claude API 格式的请求无缝转换为 OpenAI API 格式。这使得任何与 Claude API 兼容的客户端（例如官方的 @anthropic-ai/claude-code CLI）都能够与任何支持 OpenAI API 格式的服务进行通信，如 Google Gemini, Groq, Ollama 等。
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是一个部署在 Cloudflare Workers 上的 TypeScript 代理服务器，可将 Claude API 请求无缝转换为 OpenAI API 格式，支持动态路由至 Google Gemini、Groq、Ollama 等兼容服务，具备全功能 API 兼容、函数调用转换、Haiku 模型快捷配置及一键部署脚本，实现 Claude 客户端与多 AI 服务的无缝互通。
repos.summary_en: This is a TypeScript project deployed on Cloudflare Workers that acts as a proxy server, seamlessly converting Claude API requests to OpenAI API format. It enables any Claude-compatible client (e.g., @anthropic-ai/claude-code) to communicate with OpenAI-compatible services like Google Gemini, Groq, and Ollama via dynamic routing, full API compatibility, tool calling conversion, and one-click deployment.

repos.description: :metro: 即刻 Ⓙ SDK
repos.summary_zh: Jike Metro 🚇 是一个即刻（Jike）平台的 Python SDK，提供用户信息获取、动态浏览、内容发布、收藏管理、评论互动等全套接口，支持流式数据拉取与自动化操作，适用于开发者快速集成即刻生态功能。
repos.summary_en: Jike Metro 🚇 is a Python SDK for the Jike platform, offering comprehensive APIs for user profiles, news feeds, content creation, collections, comments, and interactions. It supports streaming data and automation, enabling developers to integrate Jike's ecosystem efficiently.

repos.summary_zh: Augment2Api 是一个连接 Augment API 的中间件服务，提供兼容 OpenAI 的接口，支持 Claude3.7 和 Claude4 模型调用，具备流式输出、多 token 管理、Redis 存储及批量检测功能，但存在账号被封风险，需谨慎使用。
repos.summary_en: Augment2Api is a middleware service that connects to Augment API, offering OpenAI-compatible interfaces for Claude3.7 and Claude4 models with streaming support, multi-token management, and Redis storage, though it carries account ban risks and should be used cautiously.

repos.description: 股票数据接口
repos.summary_zh: stock-open-api 是一个开源的股票数据接口库，提供从上海证券交易所和东方财富等公开数据源的股票信息查询功能，支持A股、港股、科创板、新三板及中国概念股等市场数据，适用于学习交流与量化研究场景，不可用于商业用途。
repos.summary_en: stock-open-api is an open-source library providing stock data interfaces from public sources like the Shanghai Stock Exchange and East Money, supporting queries for A-shares, Hong Kong stocks, STAR Market, New Third Board, and US-listed Chinese companies, intended for educational and research use only.

repos.description: A super blog lite -- just one page. use vue with github api !
repos.summary_zh: 基于 GitHub Issue 的单页极简博客系统，使用 Vue 和 GitHub API 构建，支持自定义配置与 CI/CD 自动化部署，适合个人知识管理与轻量级内容展示。
repos.summary_en: A minimalist single-page blog built with Vue and GitHub API, powered by GitHub Issues for content. Supports custom configuration and CI/CD via GitHub Actions for static site deployment.

repos.description: Local-first desktop API client built for developers and AI agents
repos.summary_zh: Voleeo 是一款面向 AI 时代的本地优先桌面 API 客户端，原生支持 HTTP、gRPC、WebSocket 和 GraphQL 四大协议。内置 MCP Server，允许 AI 智能体直接读写工作区、发起请求与管理环境。具备 AES-256-GCM 加密、OAuth 2.0 等全链路认证、Git 版本控制、OpenAPI/Postman 导入及插件扩展能力，零遥测、无云端锁定。
repos.summary_en: Voleeo is a local-first desktop API client built for the AI era, natively supporting HTTP, gRPC, WebSocket, and GraphQL in a single app. It doubles as an MCP server, enabling AI agents to read, create, and execute requests directly from chat. Features include AES-256-GCM encryption, full auth suites (OAuth 2.0, SigV4, etc.), Git-based collection versioning, OpenAPI/Postman imports, plugin extensibility, and zero telemetry with no cloud lock-in.

repos.description: Generate RESTful json data for Hexo plugins.
repos.summary_zh: hexo-generator-restful 是一个 Hexo 插件，可将博客内容生成 RESTful 风格的 JSON 数据，支持分页、分类、标签和文章详情等 API 接口，便于构建 SPA 应用或前后端分离架构。
repos.summary_en: hexo-generator-restful is a Hexo plugin that generates RESTful JSON data from blog content, supporting pagination, categories, tags, and article details via API endpoints, ideal for building SPA applications or decoupled front-end systems.

repos.description: 微信输入法（WeType）跨设备剪贴板的独立 Rust 客户端
repos.summary_zh: 微信输入法跨设备剪贴板的独立 Rust SDK，通过协议逆向实现文本、图片及文件的多设备同步。提供 CLI 工具 wxc，支持 macOS/Linux/Windows，基于局域网 TLS 直连传输，适合自动化脚本与跨设备数据流转场景。
repos.summary_en: An independent Rust SDK for WeType cross-device clipboard, enabling text, image, and file synchronization via protocol reverse engineering. Provides CLI wxc with multi-platform support and LAN TLS direct transfer, suitable for automation scripts and cross-device data workflows.

repos.description: Cached instances for Django REST Framework
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库为 Django REST Framework (DRF) 提供缓存实例功能，通过将序列化后的实例数据存储在缓存中，显著提升 API 读取性能。支持零数据库查询读取实例或仅一次查询获取主键列表，适用于高读负载场景。核心机制包括缓存代理类、JSON 序列化及缓存失效策略。
repos.summary_en: This project enhances Django REST Framework (DRF) by caching serialized instance data, enabling zero or minimal database queries for read-heavy APIs. It uses a cache-aware proxy to store only necessary attributes, including foreign keys and relations, improving performance for APIs with complex object relationships.

repos.description: python_sdk for TencentYoutuyun-person-face-service
repos.summary_zh: 腾讯云优图人脸服务Python SDK，提供人脸检测、比对、识别、验证及人脸库管理功能，支持本地图片与URL输入，集成API签名鉴权，适用于身份认证、安防监控等场景。
repos.summary_en: Tencent YouTu Face Service Python SDK enables face detection, comparison, recognition, and verification, with support for local images and URLs. It includes API authentication and person/group management, ideal for identity verification and security applications.

repos.description: Carbon Forum HTTP API Documentation.
repos.summary_zh: Carbon Forum HTTP API 文档为开发者提供完整的论坛接口规范，涵盖用户认证、帖子管理、通知系统等核心功能，支持分页浏览、安全验证码及头像上传，适用于构建第三方论坛客户端或集成自动化工具。
repos.summary_en: Carbon Forum HTTP API Documentation provides comprehensive interface specifications for forum operations, including user authentication, topic management, notifications, and avatar handling. It supports pagination, security codes, and is designed for building third-party clients or integrating automation tools.

repos.description: 微信支付的python接口
repos.summary_zh: weixin_pay 是一个为 Python 开发者提供的微信支付接口库，简化了微信支付 API 的调用流程。该库经过实际项目测试验证，支持核心支付功能，适合快速集成到电商、服务类应用中，提升支付模块开发效率。
repos.summary_en: weixin_pay is a Python library providing a simplified interface for WeChat Pay API. Developed for production use, it supports core payment functionalities and has been tested successfully. Ideal for integrating WeChat Pay into e-commerce or service applications efficiently.

repos.description: Python implementation of the (inactive) HTML JSON Forms spec.
repos.summary_zh: html-json-forms 是一个 Python 实现的 HTML JSON Forms 规范库，用于通过传统 HTML 表单提交结构化 JSON 数据。它采用数组式命名约定（如 items[0][name]），支持嵌套对象解析，兼容 Django REST Framework，提供功能函数与序列化器集成，适用于前后端分离场景下的表单数据处理。
repos.summary_en: html-json-forms is a Python implementation of the HTML JSON Forms specification, enabling structured JSON submission via traditional HTML forms using array-style naming (e.g., items[0][name]). It supports nested object parsing, integrates with Django REST Framework via JSONFormSerializer, and provides both functional parsing and DRF-compatible serializers for complex form data handling.

repos.description: Document Web APIs made with Django Rest Framework
repos.summary_zh: DRF Docs 是一个专为 Django Rest Framework 设计的 API 文档生成工具，支持 Python 2.7/3.x 和 Django 1.8+。它能自动解析 DRF 项目中的 API 结构，生成交互式文档页面，并提供安装配置指南、模板扩展及开发示例。项目提供实时 API 端点演示，支持隐藏文档和登录验证等配置选项，适合快速构建可维护的 RESTful API 文档。
repos.summary_en: DRF Docs is a tool to auto-generate interactive documentation for Django Rest Framework APIs, supporting Python 2.7/3.x and Django 1.8+. It parses API structures to create browsable docs with installation guides, template customization, and live demo endpoints. Features include optional doc hiding, login protection, and seamless integration via pip and URL routing, ideal for maintaining RESTful API documentation.
